calls.bash: for w in w1 w2 w3; do mu agent spawn $w -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn $w -w eval --worktree >/dev/null 2>&1; done; mu agent list -w eval
mu task claim a1 -w eval --for w1; mu task claim a2 -w eval --for w2; mu task claim a3 -w eval --for w3
for p in 'w1 a1' 'w2 a2' 'w3 a3'; do set -- $p; mu agent send $1 -w eval "do $2 and close it"; done
mu agent wait w1 w2 w3 -w eval --after-runs 0 --timeout 120 --json
mu task close a1 -w eval --evidence 'w1 will finish a1'; mu task close a2 -w eval --evidence 'w2 will finish a2'
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'carry on with a1 and close it'; mu agent send w2 -w eval 'carry on with a2 and close it'
mu agent wait w1 w2 w3 -w eval --after-runs 1 --timeout 120 --json
for w in w1 w2 w3; do git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path $w -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/$w) rev-parse HEAD) || exit 1; done

text: a1, a2 and a3 are done and merged.
